environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment with PostgreSQL 15. The database role 'order_processor' connects through PgBouncer (transaction mode). The orders table has ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and ALTER TABLE orders FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied. A policy 'tenant_isolation_policy' is defined as: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON orders USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). The role 'order_processor' is NOT a table owner and is NOT a superuser, so FORCE RLS applies. Note: the SET app.current_tenant command executes within the same transaction before the vulnerable UPDATE, meaning the RLS policy restricts the UPDATE's visible rows to only those matching the tenant_id set in the session variable. The Kafka topic uses SASL/SCRAM authentication but the ACL permits writes from the partner-facing API service account.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON orders USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
